headline: No guessing. No wasted space. Still real recovery.
dek: A lot of what you hear about home saunas is about the hassle, not the heat.
eyebrow: For people who train most days
lede: Recovery days matter as much as training days. Before you write off a home sauna as too complicated or too big a project, it's worth checking what's actually true.

reasons.heading: A home sauna needs an electrician
reasons.text: People assume a sauna means ripping open a wall and calling an electrician. The Fuji runs on a dedicated outlet you likely already have the capacity for in a garage, basement, or spare room.

proof.text: The Peak Fuji runs on a 120V / 20A outlet.

reasons.heading: It will take over the room
reasons.text: A two-person cabin sounds like a lot of square footage. In practice it's sized to fit into a corner of a bedroom, garage, or basement without turning the room into a sauna showroom.

proof.text: The Peak Fuji is built as a 2-Person cabin in Canadian red cedar.

reasons.heading: Red light therapy always costs extra
reasons.text: Red light panels are often sold as a pricey add-on elsewhere. Here it's part of the cabin itself, not a line item you have to opt into after the fact.

proof.text: Medical-grade red light therapy is included standard, not an add-on.

reasons.heading: Full-spectrum heat means a complicated setup
reasons.text: Near, mid, and far infrared sounds like a feature you'd have to manually dial in. It's built into the cabin's heater placement, so there's no extra step before a session.

proof.text: The Fuji's infrared wavelength range spans 700 to 25,000nm across near, mid, and far, reaching a max temperature of 150°F.

reasons.heading: Shipping something this big is a hassle
reasons.text: A unit this size seems like it would mean a complicated freight ordeal and a shipping bill to match. It arrives with nothing extra to pay on delivery.

proof.text: PEAK offers free shipping on all orders.

for_you.text: You train most days and want recovery you don't have to drive to.
You have space for a two-person cabin and a dedicated 120V / 20A outlet nearby.
You want red light therapy included rather than an upsell.

not_for_you.text: You need a sauna that fits more than two people at once.
You don't have a 120V / 20A outlet available where you'd place it.
You want to return it without handling disassembly and repacking.

questions.question: Do I need an electrician to install the Fuji?
questions.answer: The Fuji runs on a dedicated outlet rather than specialized wiring, so there's no need to open a wall or call an electrician first. Just confirm an outlet like this is available where you plan to place it before it arrives.

questions.question: How much space does the Fuji actually need?
questions.answer: The Fuji is built as a two-person cabin from Canadian red cedar, sized for a corner of a room rather than a dedicated structure. Measure your space against the cabin before ordering.

questions.question: Is red light therapy really included, or is it an upgrade?
questions.answer: Medical-grade red light therapy is included standard on the Fuji, not sold separately. It's part of the cabin as shipped.

questions.question: What's the difference between full-spectrum and regular infrared?
questions.answer: The Fuji's infrared range covers near, mid, and far wavelengths, from 700 to 25,000nm, reaching a max temperature of 150°F. That range is built into the heater placement, not something you configure session to session.

questions.question: Does free shipping really mean no extra fees?
questions.answer: PEAK offers free shipping on all orders, including heavy freight items delivered with a scheduled appointment. There's nothing added at checkout for delivery.

questions.question: What if I need to return it?
questions.answer: Returns require the sauna to be disassembled and repacked in its original packaging, and are subject to a 25% restocking fee with the customer covering return shipping. Orders cancelled before shipping incur a 5% cancellation fee.

questions.question: What does the warranty actually cover?
questions.answer: 7-year residential warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page. Coverage starts from the date of delivery and applies to the original purchaser.

closing.headline: The myths were the hard part

recap.text: The Fuji runs on a 120V / 20A outlet, not special wiring.
Medical-grade red light therapy comes included, not as an add-on.
Every order ships free, including freight delivery.

financing_line.text: Financing is available through Bread Pay at checkout.

warranty_line.text: 7-year residential warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page.
